description: A shell script that automates setup, cloning repositories, patching, building, testing, and coverage reporting for the entservices app gateway project. It manages dependencies, performs conditional rebuilds, and executes unit tests with coverage generation.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Ensures a git repository at a directory is checked out to a specific ref (tag, branch, or remote). Performs fetches and checkout as needed, non-interactively.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Ensures a repository exists locally by cloning if missing, then checks out to a specified ref, with optional forced reclone.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory in an idempotent manner, handling already applied patches gracefully.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a cmake project with optional force rebuild, and skips if artifacts already exist.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Determines if `apt-get` commands can be run, based on user permissions and command availability.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive git operations.
